Planning Commission
CONSOLIDATED AGENDA
December 17, 2013
6:00 P.M.
ROLL CALL
Recommended Action:
APPROVAL OF MINUTES: September 17, 2013
AGENDA CHANGES *3
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS - MATTERS NOT ON THE AGENDA
PUBLIC HEARING ITEM S
1.
PC8-253 -- Art Beat on Main Street A request for a Special Use Permit to allow for an ABC type 42 license (on-sale beer and wine for public premises) at 330 Main Street. This project is exempt from environmental review under the California Environmental Quality Act in accordance with Section 15301 of the CEQA Guidelines.
2.
PC19-074 -- E. Vista Way General Plan Amendment and Rezone A request for a General Plan Amendment from Medium High Density Residential to Commercial Neighborhood and a Rezone from R-M (15) to C-1 on a lot at the southwest corner of E. Vista Way and Taylor Street, addressed as 1806 E. Vista Way. This project is exempt from environmental review under the California Environmental Quality Act in accordance with Section 15061 of the CEQA Guidelines.
3.
PC4-074 -- Amendment to Specific Plan No. 14 A request to amend Specific Plan No. 14 to include modifying the text and the list of permitted, special, and minor uses within the Specific Plan, assigning new planning area boundaries, and adopting a new Specific Plan Map. This project is exempt from environmental review under the California Environmental Quality Act in accordance with Section 15061 of the CEQA Guidelines.
RECOMMENDATION:
Adopt Resolution 2013- , granting the request to amend Specific Plan No. 14 to include modifying the text and the list of permitted, special, and minor uses within the Specific Plan, assigning new planning area boundaries, and adopting a new Specific Plan Map.
ADJOURNMENT
